Jaishankar criticizes UN gridlock and relevance

External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar stated that the United Nations is gridlocked and no longer represents the entirety of global interests. He described the UN as "largely irrelevant" on decision-making for global crises, citing gridlock within the UN Security Council.
